description:
Configure the presentation and completion settings for the 'TechSummit 2024 Attendee Feedback' survey. Login to LimeSurvey (admin/Admin123!), navigate to the survey settings, and make the following changes:

1. Set 'Welcome message' to include: 'Welcome to the TechSummit 2024 Attendee Feedback Survey. Your responses will help us improve future events. This survey takes approximately 5 minutes to complete.'
2. Set 'End message' to include: 'Thank you for sharing your valuable feedback about TechSummit 2024. Your input directly shapes our future events.'
3. Set 'End URL' to: 'https://techsummit2024.example.com/thank-you'
4. Enable 'Automatically load URL' so respondents are redirected immediately.
5. Change 'Format' to 'Group by group'.
6. Enable 'Show progress bar'.
7. Enable 'Print answers'.
8. Enable 'Allow backward navigation' (Show 'Previous' button).

Save all settings when finished.
